// diagnostic

E0749

A function reaches an effect outside a ceiling it answers to (a package `authority` `allow` row or a module `#FX(…)` cap), or one a `-[!E]>` row, module cap or package `deny` prohibits, including a denied `Panic` stop

What

A function reaches an effect outside a ceiling it answers to (a package `authority` `allow` row or a module `#FX(…)` cap), or one a `-[!E]>` row, module cap or package `deny` prohibits, including a denied `Panic` stop

Why

The registered sema rule names the effect or panic site, the call chain that reaches it and the scope that set the limit

Fix

Remove the offending effect, return a fallible result, add facts or a `#Pre`/refinement proof, widen the ceiling, or drop the prohibition

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0749: tests/ui/c_import_reaches_past_allow_row_listing_ffi_c.stderr.

Error [jet.ProhibitedEffectReached]: `c_import_reaches_past_allow_row_listing_ffi_c::run` reaches the `Browser, DB, Env, Exec, FFI, FS, GPU, Log, Meta, Net, Rand, Secret, Time` effect, which the package's `authority: { allow: […] }` row doesn't list
  --> tests/ui/c_import_reaches_past_allow_row_listing_ffi_c.jet:12:1
    |
 12 | run: fn() {
    | ^^^
 Why: A written `allow` row is a ceiling: the package's code and every call it makes may use only the listed effects and the floor every program holds (`IO`, `Mem.Alloc`, `Exec.Args`)
 Fix: Add `Browser, DB, Env, Exec, FFI, FS, GPU, Log, Meta, Net, Rand, Secret, Time` to `authority.allow`, or remove the call that reaches it
 Note: `c_import_reaches_past_allow_row_listing_ffi_c::run` calls a C binding no descriptor owns; the checker cannot see its body, so the call reaches every effect
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: c_import_reaches_past_allow_row_listing_ffi_c::run
